Content.SourceString: 这……看上去有点瘆人。万理先生，没事吧？

Content.SourceString: 是{0}吗？我是知远，暂用父亲的手机和你联络。
Content.LocalizedString: Is this {0}? This is Kilos. I'm using my father's phone to contact you.

Content.SourceString: 长歌托我联络你，希望你能来报刊亭一趟。
Content.LocalizedString: Aria asked me to contact you. She hopes you can come to the newsstand.

Content.SourceString: 作战计划已经决定了吗？
Content.LocalizedString: We got a plan yet?

Content.SourceString: 我这就来。
Content.LocalizedString: I'm on my way.

Content.SourceString: 似乎是这样，不过详情还是让她自己介绍吧。
Content.LocalizedString: It seems that way, but I'll let her explain the details herself.

Content.SourceString: 不急，路上要注意安全。
Content.LocalizedString: No rush. Safe travels.

Content.SourceString: 我会把父亲也送去报刊亭，请你们今天多关照他。如果有任何情况，千万立刻联系我。
Content.LocalizedString: I'll bring my father to the newsstand too. Please take good care of him today. If anything happens, contact me immediately.

Content.SourceString: 本来我也该同去，可之前为了来海特洛照顾父亲紧急请假，耽搁了许多工作，现在有些急事必须处理，实在脱不开身……这种时候不能陪同，真是惭愧。
Content.LocalizedString: I should be going with you, but I had to take emergency leave earlier to come to Hethereau and care for my father, which put me behind on a lot of work. Now I have some urgent matters I must handle and simply can't get away… I'm truly sorry I can't be there at a time like this.

Content.SourceString: 放心，我们会照顾好万理先生。
Content.LocalizedString: Don't worry, we'll take good care of Miles.

Content.SourceString: 工作要紧，先去忙吧。我们这边也会努力。
Content.LocalizedString: Work comes first, go take care of it. We'll do our best on our end too.

Content.SourceString: 放心，我们会照顾好万理先生。
Content.LocalizedString: Don't worry, we'll take good care of Miles.

Content.SourceString: 工作要紧，先去忙吧。我们这边也会努力。
Content.LocalizedString: Work comes first, go take care of it. We'll do our best on our end too.

Content.SourceString: 小友，先前的事多劳你费心了。托你们几位的福，我身体无大碍，现在已经出院，一切安好，不必挂怀。
Content.LocalizedString: Young friend, thank you for all your concern regarding what happened before. Thanks to you and the others, my health is fine. I've been discharged from the hospital now and everything is well, so please don't worry.

Content.SourceString: 这次麻烦了你不少，心下感念，还是想当面道谢。此外，长歌那孩子也说想向你致谢。不知你何时得闲，方便来店里小聚片刻？
Content.LocalizedString: You've been quite helpful this time, and I'm truly grateful. I'd still like to thank you in person. Besides, young Aria also said she wants to express her gratitude to you. I wonder when you might be free to drop by the shop for a brief visit?

OptionText.SourceString: 太郑重不知道怎么回复……
OptionText.LocalizedString: It's so formal that I don't know how to reply…

Content.SourceString: 认识万理先生以来，还是第一次看到语言这么流畅的短信……有点感动。
Content.LocalizedString: Ever since I've known Miles, this is the first time I've seen such an eloquently written message from him… I'm kind of moved.

Content.SourceString: 万理先生的短信内容太郑重了，都不知道该怎么回话……
Content.LocalizedString: Miles's message is so formal that I don't even know how to reply…

Content.SourceString: 这……之前种种，还是太劳烦你了。
Content.LocalizedString: Well… with everything that happened before, I've really caused you too much trouble.

Content.SourceString: 毕竟年事已高，平日闲谈不影响，一提笔成文，难免拘泥词句，显得迂腐僵硬了。小友莫要在意，随意些便好。
Content.LocalizedString: After all, I'm getting on in years. Casual conversation is fine, but when I put pen to paper, I inevitably get caught up in formal phrasing and end up sounding stuffy and rigid. Don't mind it, young friend. Just be casual.

Content.SourceString: 现在二位都在报刊亭吧？我很快就到。
Content.LocalizedString: You two are both at the newsstand now, right? I'll be there soon.

Content.SourceString: 二人都在店，小友莫着急，路上小心些。
Content.LocalizedString: Both of them are at the shop. Don't worry, young friend, and be careful on your way.
